json.blurb: Your entire model — objects, connections, flows, tags and domains, with all granular metadata.

pdf.blurb: A formatted summary document to share with stakeholders.

markdown.blurb: A Markdown summary — drop it straight into a wiki or repo.

llms.blurb: A plain-text summary structured for large language models.

csv.blurb: A spreadsheet of your model objects or connections.

structurizr.blurb: A Structurizr DSL workspace — model plus structural views, re-importable here or in Structurizr.

structurizrJson.blurb: A Structurizr workspace.json — the same model, and unlike the DSL it also carries the layout, so your diagrams arrive arranged the way you drew them.

mermaid.blurb: A Mermaid C4 diagram — paste it into docs, wikis or mermaid.live.

svg.blurb: The current diagram as a scalable vector image.

png.blurb: The current diagram as a high-resolution raster image.

included.imageBlocked: Open a diagram first — image exports capture the diagram you are working on.
included.json: {{scope}}: domains, flows, model connections, model objects, groups and tags — with every field of metadata.
included.structurizr: {{scope}} as a Structurizr DSL workspace: model elements, relationships and structural views.
included.structurizrJson: {{scope}} as a Structurizr workspace.json: model elements, relationships, views — and the position of every shape on every view, which the DSL cannot express.
included.mermaidDiagram: The “{{name}}” diagram as a Mermaid C4 diagram, at its own level.
included.mermaidLandscape: The whole landscape as one Mermaid C4 context diagram with system boundaries.
included.summary: Model objects, connections, flows and tags in {{scope}}.{{diagramNote}}
included.summaryDiagramNote: The “{{name}}” diagram is drawn into the document.
included.csvConnections: One row per connection: sender & receiver, direction, status, technology and description.
included.csvObjects: One row per object: name, type, status, tags, technology and links. Connections and flows are not included.
included.svg: The “{{name}}” diagram as scalable vectors, in {{theme}} theme.
included.png: The “{{name}}” diagram in {{theme}} theme, at {{scale}}× resolution.
included.png3d: The live 3D board of “{{name}}”, exactly as framed, at {{scale}}× resolution.
included.legendSeparate: A legend of its shapes and connections downloads as a second file.
included.legendEmbedded: A legend of its shapes and connections is drawn into the image.
